mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish: we have clear skies with a temperature of 76 degrees near Badger Ridge Middle School and a moderate air quality index of 60.

The city has two big updates today. First, you can join the virtual meeting on August 6 to see the final design for the new skatepark. Second, voting for the I Voted sticker contest is open until August 7, where you can help choose the designs for this November's election.

There is plenty to do today, including the Verona Downtown Farmer's Market at Hometown Junction Park, trivia at The Bogey Factory, and yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, don't miss the free Concerts in the Park at Century School Park.
In a report covering July 20 to July 27, a noteworthy incident occurred on Friday, July 25, when a 29-year-old Madison woman was arrested for her first O W I offence.

The flavor of the day is Caramel Peanut Buttercup and the store is open until 10 PM. If you want a cool treat while you are out, Kona Ice is visiting Fireman's Park today from 11 AM to 4:30 PM and the Verona Farmers Market from 3 PM to 6:30 PM.
